# Decision log

**Owner:** Solution Architect

Architectural decisions (AD) in ADR form: context, decision, consequences. A decision stays until it is superseded; the current design in `docs/sad.md` and `docs/lld/` reflects the active decisions. Decisions at implementation level are DES rows in `docs/lld/14-design-decisions.md`. Item format: the `spec-authoring` skill, Section 3.
